name: @quarry/code-workspace-worker
description: Code Workspace sessions: starts and stops each user's IDE container (Docker), serves the IDE through its gateway, and runs previews in them. NestJS app (BullMQ processor + gateway + GET /health). No database access — talks to the server's /internal API.

scripts.dev: nodemon -w src -w ../shared -e ts,json --exec ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/main.ts
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.build.json
